# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage

meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction

Our constant focus on cost and accessibility make our thrusters, components, USV, and underwater ROV
the most affordable on the market.

### Flexible & Expandable

Straightforward designs with open source software and hardware allow for customization,
modification, and reconfiguration.

### A Community of Explorers

Our products come with clear documentation and resources as well as a diverse community of subsea
explorers, hobbyists, and professional users.

3

### Identify Treatment Pathways

options relevant to your case.

4

### Coordinate Next Steps

We help arrange specialist consultations, hospital admissions, additional diagnostics, logistics,

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India,
and the USA. Our team conducts an initial eligibility review, communicates with trial centers, and
guides patients through screening, documentation, and enrollment.

### End-to-End Care Coordination

From preparing medical documents and communicating with hospitals to appointment scheduling, visa
assistance, travel planning, admission support, and continuity of care, CancerFax coordinates the
complete treatment journey. This allows patients and their families to focus on treatment while we
manage the clinical and logistical details.

Our Difference

## Why Patients Choose CancerFax?

"We don't book hospitals. We walk beside families navigating the hardest decisions of their lives,
with compassion, care, and commitment that doesn't waver."

### Advanced Treatment Focus

Specialized expertise in therapies that are often inaccessible locally, cell therapy, gene therapy,
precision oncology, and clinical trials.

### Cross-Border Coordination

Comprehensive support across international treatment destinations, case review, admissions, hospital
communication, and logistics.

### Hospital & Doctor Navigation

Guidance on the right institutions, specialist matching based on diagnosis, and center selection
tailored to clinical complexity.

### Clinical Trial Awareness

Support in identifying and exploring clinical trial options when appropriate, including
mutation-specific and late-line investigational pathways.

### Compassionate Support

Human guidance for patients and families navigating difficult decisions, with emphasis on clarity,
honesty, and realistic, informed hope.

### Independent Second Opinions

Access trusted second opinions from global cancer specialists, ensuring every diagnosis, treatment
plan, and decision is reviewed with expert clarity.

Our Process

## How It Works?

A clear, structured, and compassionate four-step process designed to bring order to a difficult
moment.

1

### Share Your Reports

Upload your pathology reports, imaging results, treatment history, and any relevant clinical
documents securely through our platform.

2

### Our Team Reviews Your Case

CancerFax specialists conduct a thorough clinical review of your diagnosis, disease stage,
biomarkers, and treatment history.

3

### Identify Treatment Pathways

We explore suitable advanced therapies, clinical trial opportunities, and international treatment
options relevant to your case.

4

### Coordinate Next Steps

We help arrange specialist consultations, hospital admissions, additional diagnostics, logistics,
and ongoing care coordination.

### **1 in 5 women suffer from heavy menstrual bleeding.¹**

With bleeding that soaks through menstrual products for hours or days in a row, it can feel
impossible to keep up with all of your normal daily activities – always worrying about having a
bathroom nearby.

[ Learn More ][61]

## Introducing Cerene® Cryotherapy

Cerene is a treatment designed to provide relief from your heavy and painful periods, getting you
back to a life controlled by you, not your period.
* **2 1/2 minute treatment time using cooling technology**
* **No anesthesia needed**
* **No incisions**
* **Done right in your doctor’s office**

[ Learn more ][62]

## Real Patient Results

#### reported normal, light, or no periods after Cerene†

#### had a reduction in cramping‡

#### would recommend Cerene to family and friends†††

† Patient-reported data are 1 year after treatment with durable results at 3 years
‡ Improvement reported one year after treatment for patients reporting severe / very severe cramping
††† Patient-reported data include definitely and consider recommending Cerene and are 1 year after
treatment with durable results at 3 years

[ Clinical Outcomes ][63]

### Providers

### Patients

**Important Safety Information**

Cerene® Cryotherapy Device is indicated to ablate the endometrial lining of the uterus in
premenopausal women with heavy menstrual bleeding due to benign causes for whom childbearing is
complete. Pregnancy following the Cerene procedure can be dangerous; therefore, contraception must
be used until menopause. The Cerene procedure is not for those who have or suspect uterine cancer;
have an active genital, urinary or pelvic infection; or an IUD. There are risks and considerations
associated with the use of the Cerene Cryotherapy Device. Temporary side effects may include uterine
cramping, vaginal infection, and lightheadedness. For detailed benefit and risk information, consult
the Cerene Instructions for Use (IFU) or your healthcare professional. CAUTION: Federal (USA) law
restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician trained in the use of the Cerene
Cryotherapy Device. [**Learn More**][64]

# Luxury Cold Wellness. Built Colder. Built Better.

CryoBuilt designs and manufactures ultra-low-temperature cryotherapy systems for operators,
institutions, and private clients who demand performance, longevity, and absolute control over their
cold wellness environment.

Request Equipment Information
[ [chillybox cryo chamber] ][32]

### Chillybox

A true plug-and-play system built for private residences & light commercial use, bringing
professional cryotherapy into the comfort of home or boutique wellness offering.

[ Learn more ][33]
[ [Cryobuilt Polaris] ][34]

### Polaris

Polaris is a self-contained electric cryotherapy chamber within CryoBuilt’s equipment portfolio,
purpose-built for single-user sessions in professional environments with appropriate hosting
conditions.

[ Learn more ][35]

### Everest

Fully electric cryotherapy equipment engineered for high-throughput environments, supporting
multi-user sessions with sustained ultra-low-temperature performance during continuous operation.

[ Learn more ][36]
[ [Cryobuilt Tundra] ][37]

### Tundra

Tundra is CryoBuilt’s most refined electric cryotherapy chamber, the luxury platform within the
CryoBuilt portfolio. While other models scale for height or capacity, Tundra is engineered around
spatial experience, airflow orientation, and architectural precision.

[ Learn more ][38]

### Nordic

CryoBuilt’s largest electric cryotherapy equipment, engineered for multi-user capacity and sustained
ultra-low-temperature performance in high-volume professional environments.

[ Learn more ][39]
[ [cryo chamber hand and ear accessories] ][40]

### Accessories

Purpose-built accessories designed to enhance performance, comfort, and the cryotherapy experience.

[ Learn more ][41]

CryoBuilt supports recovery environments where performance matters most,from professional sports
organizations to leading wellness facilities. Our equipment operates in 600+ locations across 8+
countries, and continues to scale globally.

[fingerprint-2.png]

### **Fingerprint Authorization**

### Two fingerprint authorizations are required to operate the XR cryotherapy chamber, one via an
### approved operator and one via an approved user. 

[door.png]

### **Operator Required**

### The XR cryotherapy chamber requires an operator to be present during a session.

[lock.png]

### **Door Design**

### The door never locks and requires little force to open. The door itself contains a proximity
### sensor which triggers the valves to shut down when open.

[chamber-3.png]

### **Interior Geometry**

### Designed in such a way that if the user's head falls below the top opening for any reason,
### physical limitations will force the door open, activating the door sensor. 

[pulse-sensor.png]

### **Pulse Oxygen Sensor**

### Informs the client of their pulse and blood oxygen levels during the session (for entertainment
### purposes only).

[head-sensor.png]

### **Head Sensor**

### If the user’s head falls below the safety level, the valves automatically shut down.

[emergency-button.png]

### **Emergency Stop Button**

### Deenergizes valves and heaters, preventing chamber operation. 

[valve-2.png]

### **Emergency Shut-off **

### Isolates the chamber from the tank, preventing Nitrogen flow.

[gloves-and-boots.png]

### **Protective Equipment**

### Personal Protective Equipment is provided to protect user’s extremities.

### **MINIMAL LIABILITY** - The XR includes several industry leading safety features that minimize
### owner liability:

[fingerprint-2.png]

### **Fingerprint Authorization**

### Two fingerprint authorizations are required to operate the XR cryotherapy chamber, one via an
### approved operator and one via an approved user. 

[door.png]

### **Operator Required**

### The XR cryotherapy chamber requires an operator to be present during a session.

[lock.png]

### **Door Design**

### The door never locks and requires little force to open. The door itself contains a proximity
### sensor which triggers the valves to shut down when open.

[chamber-3.png]

### **Interior Geometry**

### Designed in such a way that if the user's head falls below the top opening for any reason,
### physical limitations will force the door open, activating the door sensor. 

[pulse-sensor.png]

### **Pulse Oxygen Sensor**

### Informs the client of their pulse and blood oxygen levels during the session (for entertainment
### purposes only).

[head-sensor.png]

### **Head Sensor**

### If the user’s head falls below the safety level, the valves automatically shut down.

[emergency-button.png]

### **Emergency Stop Button**

### Deenergizes valves and heaters, preventing chamber operation. 

[valve-2.png]

### **Emergency Shut-off **

### Isolates the chamber from the tank, preventing Nitrogen flow.

[gloves-and-boots.png]

### **Protective Equipment**

### Personal Protective Equipment is provided to protect user’s extremities.

## [Cryotherapy Equipment][90]

### [Local Cryotherapy Devices][91]

Cryofans are body care devices for localized treatments operating on vaporized nitrogen. Cryomed's
cryoblowers work with extremely low temperatures ranging from -80℃ to -120℃. Spot cryotherapy
devices are widely used in beauty salons, health clinics or med spas, recovery labs, fitness and
wellness centers.

### [Whole-Body Cryotherapy Machines][92]

A cryosauna is an open-top device for whole-body cryogenic treatments. Such cryotherapy machine
rapidly cools down the skin with freezingly cold nitrogen vapor and air mix. The resulting thermal
shock prompts reduced inflammation and pain relief, energy boost, and lower stress levels. A series
of treatments produces far-reaching positive effects, like managing chronic pain, improving
immunity, shedding extra weight, and boosting vitality.

### [Mobile Cryotherapy Equipment][93]

Forget about improvised mobile cryotherapy rooms. Meet a new offer from Cryomed: a minibus with the
tastefully decorated interior fully equipped for a quality cryotherapy experience on the go! Our
mobile cryotherapy unit – Cryobus – is now available for our customers worldwide.

## General Questions

[Read all FAQ][113]

##### Do cryo chambers have significant differences?

Cryomed produces several types of cryosaunas. For example, Cryomed One and Cryomed Pro are
whole-body cryotherapy devices while Cryofan is a device for local cryotherapy. The main differences
of Cryomed One from the flagship Cryomed Pro are compact dimensions, lower weight and, as a result,
lower cost. Cryomed Pro M (Medical) is also a whole-body device that is certified for usage in
medical facilities.

##### Are you a cryosauna manufacturer? Or just a reseller?

For over 18 years, Cryomed has been at the forefront among the MANUFACTURERS of cryotherapy machines
and cryospa solutions. Cryomed manufactures its own cryotherapy devices in ISO certified European
factory. We do not resell third-party cryosaunas, both new or used.

##### What are the industry regulations for cryotherapy?

The cryotherapy chamber is not regulated as a medical device in the USA. However, our Cryomed Pro M
model has gone through all security, safety and efficacy European tests by Institute for Testing and
Certification. This means that our device Cryomed PRO M has been certified as meeting the
requirements of Directive 93/42/EEC on medical devices, Annex II excluding (4) and is officially a
Medical Cryotherapy Device class 2B. See [all certificates for cryosaunas][114] of our company.

##### Will your cryosaunas be safe for our future customers?

Yes, Cryomed guarantees the safety of all cryosauna models that are presented in the catalogue. For
example, “Cryomed Pro” cryotherapy machine contains CE approved electronic system controlled by
touch screen TECO. It’s also equipped with an emergency stop button outside and an accident
prevention system inside the cabin. For detailed information, see Technical Specifications. We are
ready to help – get a free consultation right now!

##### What is the cost of a cryosauna?

The cost of cryosauna varies depending on the type of cryosauna you need and additional features –
colour, cabin size, redesigned multicolour TOP LED lighting and many others. Please contact our
sales department to get detailed information!

##### Do you work with the UK? Ireland? Canada? Australia?

Yes, as a manufacturer of cryo chambers, Cryomed is interested in cryosauna supplies to different
countries of the world. Many of our clients started their cryotherapy business in the USA and the
EU. Look at our Cryotherapy Map and Partners page to find information about our current partners and
cryosauna distributors in the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia and other countries. Take a chance and
join now!

##### How to become cryosauna distributor in my country?

Cryomed is a reliable cryotherapy equipment supplier! Please contact us!

## The positive effects of cryotherapy

Cryotherapy stimulates the immune system, and initiates regeneration processes in the body.
Cryotherapy is commonly used in modern sports medicine.

Cryotherapy also expedites rehabilitation after injuries. In the beauty and cosmetics industry,
cryotherapy sessions are used for improving blood circulation, skin rejuvenation, anti-aging
therapy, and for removing toxins from the body.

In the medical field, cryo sessions are helpful in recovering from illness or surgery, treating skin
diseases, and improving general well-being.

[Request your price][91]

## Cryosaunas FAQ

[brush-2]

##### Do cryo chambers have significant differences?

Cryomed produces several types of cryosaunas. For example, Cryomed One and Cryomed Pro are
whole-body cryotherapy devices while Cryofan is a device for local cryotherapy. The main differences
of Cryomed One from the flagship Cryomed Pro are compact dimensions, lower weight and, as a result,
lower cost. Cryomed Pro M (Medical) is also a whole-body device that is certified for usage in
medical facilities.

##### Are you a cryosauna manufacturer? Or just a reseller?

For over 18 years, Cryomed has been at the forefront among the MANUFACTURERS of cryotherapy machines
and cryospa solutions. Cryomed manufactures its own cryotherapy devices in ISO certified European
factory. We do not resell third-party cryosaunas, both new or used.

##### What are the industry regulations for cryotherapy?

The cryotherapy chamber is not regulated as a medical device in the USA. However, our Cryomed Pro M
model has gone through all security, safety and efficacy European tests by Institute for Testing and
Certification. This means that our device Cryomed PRO M has been certified as meeting the
requirements of Directive 93/42/EEC on medical devices, Annex II excluding (4) and is officially a
Medical Cryotherapy Device class 2B. See [all certificates for cryosaunas][92] of our company.

##### Will your cryosaunas be safe for our future customers?

Yes, Cryomed guarantees the safety of all cryosauna models that are presented in the catalogue. For
example, “Cryomed Pro” cryotherapy machine contains CE approved electronic system controlled by
touch screen TECO. It’s also equipped with an emergency stop button outside and an [accident
prevention system][93] inside the cabin. For detailed information, see Technical Specifications. We
are ready to help – get a free consultation right now!

The cost of cryosauna varies depending on the type of cryosauna you need and additional features –

## The positive effects of cryotherapy

Cryotherapy stimulates the immune system, and initiates regeneration processes in the body.
Cryotherapy is commonly used in modern sports medicine.

Cryotherapy also expedites rehabilitation after injuries. In the beauty and cosmetics industry,
cryotherapy sessions are used for improving blood circulation, skin rejuvenation, anti-aging
therapy, and for removing toxins from the body.

In the medical field, cryo sessions are helpful in recovering from illness or surgery, treating skin
diseases, and improving general well-being.

## Cryosaunas FAQ

[brush-2]

##### Do cryo chambers have significant differences?

Cryomed produces several types of cryosaunas. For example, Cryomed One and Cryomed Pro are
whole-body cryotherapy devices while Cryofan is a device for local cryotherapy. The main differences
of Cryomed One from the flagship Cryomed Pro are compact dimensions, lower weight and, as a result,
lower cost. Cryomed Pro M (Medical) is also a whole-body device that is certified for usage in
medical facilities.

##### Are you a cryosauna manufacturer? Or just a reseller?

For over 18 years, Cryomed has been at the forefront among the MANUFACTURERS of cryotherapy machines
and cryospa solutions. Cryomed manufactures its own cryotherapy devices in ISO certified European
factory. We do not resell third-party cryosaunas, both new or used.

##### What are the industry regulations for cryotherapy?

The cryotherapy chamber is not regulated as a medical device in the USA. However, our Cryomed Pro M
model has gone through all security, safety and efficacy European tests by Institute for Testing and
Certification. This means that our device Cryomed PRO M has been certified as meeting the
requirements of Directive 93/42/EEC on medical devices, Annex II excluding (4) and is officially a
Medical Cryotherapy Device class 2B. See [all certificates for cryosaunas][92] of our company.

##### Will your cryosaunas be safe for our future customers?

Yes, Cryomed guarantees the safety of all cryosauna models that are presented in the catalogue. For
example, “Cryomed Pro” cryotherapy machine contains CE approved electronic system controlled by
touch screen TECO. It’s also equipped with an emergency stop button outside and an [accident
prevention system][93] inside the cabin. For detailed information, see Technical Specifications. We
are ready to help – get a free consultation right now!

See also:
[Do I need cryosauna if I own a medical center?][94]
[Do I need cryosauna if I own a fitness/sport center?][95]
Do I need cryosauna [if I own a beauty salon?][96]

##### What is the cost of cryosauna?

The cost of cryosauna varies depending on the type of cryosauna you need and additional features –
colour, cabin size, redesigned multicolour TOP LED lighting and [many others][97]. Please contact
our sales department to get detailed information!

##### Do you work with the UK? Ireland? Canada? Australia?..

Yes, as a manufacturer of cryo chambers, Cryomed is interested in cryosauna supplies to different
countries of the world. Many of our clients started their cryotherapy business in the USA and the
EU. Look at our Cryotherapy Map and Partners page to find information about our current partners and
cryosauna distributors in the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia and other countries. Take a chance and
join now!

## Prioritizing the health and well-being of your horse is our mission.

We are dedicated to creating a calm and supportive environment for both horses and their owners.

Your horse deserves the best and you deserve to give your horse the best.

[ Schedule an appointment today! ][20]
View fullsize

**Feedback from Our Clients**
* ## “We had such a great experience with Bailey caring for our animals – and all of them. We have
  ## donkeys, mules, pigs and chickens! Even when our plans changed at the last minute she was very
  ## accommodating and flexible to ensure our animals were well cared for. Everyone seemed happy and
  ## everything was nice and tidy when we returned home. We are already planning our next trip and
  ## entrusting Bailey to care for our animals again! Highly recommend!”
  
  ***Lisa M.***
* ## "Bailey stayed at my farm for the first time this week. I was gone for 4 days and have four
  ## horses and two cats. She planned for the trip well, communicated throughout the process, sent
  ## twice daily pictures and updates and left the house and barn very clean. I can’t wait to book
  ## my next vacation now that I have a great new farm sitter. Strongly recommend!"
  
  ***Samantha S.***
* ## "Bailey did a wonderful job taking care of my goats and chickens while I was out of town. She
  ## was kind, professional and detailed oriented. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking
  ## for skilled care of their animals when they go out of town. She communicated well and was
  ## lovely to the animals."
  
  ***Jessica M.***
* ## "Bailey provided extraordinary care for our little herd of four during a recent heatwave. She
  ## doted on a mini who was becoming dehydrated and had all the right instincts before I even
  ## relayed the vet’s advice. She made sure Charlie had plenty of soupy mashes and cool water and
  ## checked his vitals. Everyone else was hosed off. The reassurance of Fig & Honey Horse Care at
  ## home made vacation more relaxing!"
  
  Catherine G.

## Follow us on social

[ Instagram ][21]
[ Facebook ][22]

# Fig & Honey Horse Care

### FAQ’s
* #### I have other animals besides horses, will your services apply?
  
  Yes, absolutely. If you have other animals that need our services, we would be happy to provide
  what is needed. We are experienced and fully insured for household pet care as well as equine
  care! Additional costs may apply.
* #### What geographical areas do we service?
  
  Serving Berkshire County and parts of Hampshire County. Contact us to see if you are within our
  service range!
* #### What times are we available for services?
  
  Our hours depend on your needs! If you require early morning or late night care, we are here to
  help. Call or email today to schedule an appointment.
* #### Don't see the service you are looking for?
  
  The services we provide are not limited to what is listed above. If you do not see the service you
  require, please reach out to me via email or phone so that we can best assist you.
* #### Cancellation Policy
  
  We value your time and our resources. To ensure that we can serve all our clients fairly, please
  review our cancellation policy.
  
  Cancellation Notice:
  
  Cancellations made two weeks before of services will forfeit the deposit placed during booking.
  
  Emergencies:
  
  We understand that emergencies happen. In the event of illness or an emergency, please contact us
  as soon as possible. We may waive the cancellation fee at our discretion.

## Contact Us

Interested in working together? Fill out some info and we will be in touch shortly. We can’t wait to
hear from you!

Please call or email to schedule an appointment:

Email: [fighoneyhc@gmail.com][23]

Phone Number: [413-464-3485][24]

* ## “We had such a great experience with Bailey caring for our animals – and all of them. We have
  ## donkeys, mules, pigs and chickens! Even when our plans changed at the last minute she was very
  ## accommodating and flexible to ensure our animals were well cared for. Everyone seemed happy and
  ## everything was nice and tidy when we returned home. We are already planning our next trip and
  ## entrusting Bailey to care for our animals again! Highly recommend!”
  
  ***Lisa M.***
* ## "Bailey stayed at my farm for the first time this week. I was gone for 4 days and have four
  ## horses and two cats. She planned for the trip well, communicated throughout the process, sent
  ## twice daily pictures and updates and left the house and barn very clean. I can’t wait to book
  ## my next vacation now that I have a great new farm sitter. Strongly recommend!"
  
  ***Samantha S.***
* ## "Bailey did a wonderful job taking care of my goats and chickens while I was out of town. She
  ## was kind, professional and detailed oriented. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking
  ## for skilled care of their animals when they go out of town. She communicated well and was
  ## lovely to the animals."
  
  ***Jessica M.***
* ## "Bailey provided extraordinary care for our little herd of four during a recent heatwave. She
  ## doted on a mini who was becoming dehydrated and had all the right instincts before I even
  ## relayed the vet’s advice. She made sure Charlie had plenty of soupy mashes and cool water and
  ## checked his vitals. Everyone else was hosed off. The reassurance of Fig & Honey Horse Care at
  ## home made vacation more relaxing!"

## About Fin Tube Products

**Fin Tube Products, Inc.** specializes in Helical-Wound Brazed Finned Tubing. We are tooled
however, to provide many of the fin to tube attachment methods currently available in today’s
market.

Our Finned tubing and finned pipe are used in heat exchangers, boiler economizers, coolers, and
heaters. Our small diameter to miniature finned tubes (hypodermic) can be found in cryostats and
cryogenic coolers for military use, or in the medical profession for the cryoablation of tumors.

With the use of our in house [Atmospheric Brazing Furnace][60] complete control is maintained over
the critical brazing process. By avoiding the out sourcing of our brazing your turn around time is
improved, and complete quality control is maintained in house.

Fin Tube Products, Inc. offers one of the worlds most diversified finned tubing product lines.
Although specializing in a helically wound brazed finned tube, we offer many of the other forms of
fin to tube attachments available in today’s market. Our [Finbraze®][61] and [Cladfin® fin
tubes][62] are available in straight lengths, shapes or [coils][63]. We offer prototype or
production runs. Pricing and delivery is competitive. Our quality is second to none.

## About Fin Tube Products

**Fin Tube Products, Inc.** specializes in Helical-Wound Brazed Finned Tubing. We are tooled
however, to provide many of the fin to tube attachment methods currently available in today’s
market.

Our Finned tubing and finned pipe are used in heat exchangers, boiler economizers, coolers, and
heaters. Our small diameter to miniature finned tubes (hypodermic) can be found in cryostats and
cryogenic coolers for military use, or in the medical profession for the cryoablation of tumors.

With the use of our in house [Atmospheric Brazing Furnace][60] complete control is maintained over
the critical brazing process. By avoiding the out sourcing of our brazing your turn around time is
improved, and complete quality control is maintained in house.

Fin Tube Products, Inc. offers one of the worlds most diversified finned tubing product lines.
Although specializing in a helically wound brazed finned tube, we offer many of the other forms of
fin to tube attachments available in today’s market. Our [Finbraze®][61] and [Cladfin® fin
tubes][62] are available in straight lengths, shapes or [coils][63]. We offer prototype or
production runs. Pricing and delivery is competitive. Our quality is second to none.

[professional shockwave therapy machine LGT-2500X (1)]
Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates
the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body. By squeezing the
proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation and the lymphatic
system, improve body micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, and reduce limb swelling. It addresses
diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. It is widely used in hospital settings to improve
workflow efficiency and enhance patient care. 

[Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT][127]
[LGT-2201DVT]
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT

The LGT-2201DVT is a compression therapy device. It is composed of an intermittent pneumatic
controller (main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. The working principle is that air inflates
and deflates the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body.

By squeezing the proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation
and the lymphatic system, improve the body's micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, reduce limb
swelling, and address diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. Suitable places for use are
clinics and hospitals. 

[Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT][128]
[Compression Therapy Device LGT-2202DVT]
LGT - 2202DVT DVT Pump for Hospitals

The LGT-2202DVT is a gradient-pressure compression therapy system engineered to lower the risk of

## Pioneering Physiotherapy and Medical Aesthetic Innovations

Unleashing Advanced Technology in Physiotherapy & Medical Aesthetics

[
More Products
][116]

Longest medical works to provide high-quality, cost-effective, and durable physiotherapy equipment,
aesthetic equipment, and rehabilitation devices that are extensively used in sports physiotherapy,
neurological rehabilitation, orthopedics, post-surgical recovery, musculoskeletal physiotherapy,
pain management, and aesthetic medicine.

[28th Madrid World Congress ISMST]
[FDA Approves Longest LGT-2320 Low-Frequency NMES/TENS Devices]
[Longest Medical KEY-products 2026]
[Precision Cold,Optimal Pain Relief]
[Advanced ESWT Device,Enhanced Musculoskeletal Health]
[3 in 1 Combo,Expanded Treatment Capability]
[professional shockwave therapy machine LGT-2500X (1)]
Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates
the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body. By squeezing the
proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation and the lymphatic
system, improve body micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, and reduce limb swelling. It addresses
diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. It is widely used in hospital settings to improve
workflow efficiency and enhance patient care. 

[Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT][127]
[LGT-2201DVT]
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT

The LGT-2201DVT is a compression therapy device. It is composed of an intermittent pneumatic
controller (main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. The working principle is that air inflates
and deflates the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body.

By squeezing the proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation
and the lymphatic system, improve the body's micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, reduce limb
swelling, and address diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. Suitable places for use are
clinics and hospitals. 

[Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT][128]
[Compression Therapy Device LGT-2202DVT]
LGT - 2202DVT DVT Pump for Hospitals

The LGT-2202DVT is a gradient-pressure compression therapy system engineered to lower the risk of

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

## innovative and path-breaking medical devices.

Consciously contributing to alleviate ailments, we partner with the global medical fraternity across
various specialties.

## Founded in 2006

Meril is an India-based, global medical device company that is dedicated to design and manufacture
clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

## Our Purpose

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,
including cardiovascular, orthopedics, robotics, diagnostics, and oncology, aimed at alleviating
human suffering.

### Boyun Fıtığı Tedavileri

Ozon, radyofrekans veya lazer diskektomi yöntemlerinden kişiye uygun olanseçilerek fıtığın içine
iğne ile girerek küçültücü işlem (farmako termal regresyon) yapılır. Yaklaşık 3 ay içinde fıtık
geriler ve sinir basısı azalır.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi]

### Ameliyatsız Tiroid
### Tedavisi

Ciltten girimle (Radyofrekans, Mikrodalga, Kriyoablasyon) nodül yakılarak (ablasyon) ya da çok büyük
guatrlarda ve de Basedow Graves hastalığında embolizasyon yöntemiyle, ameliyatsız olarak 30 dakikada
tedavi sağlanır. Nodüller küçülür ve semptomlar giderilir ve hastalar tiroid ilacı kullanmazlar.

[Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri][Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri]

### Kanser Hastalıkları
### Tedavileri

Kanser tedavisinde girişimsel radyoloji yöntemleriyle, tümöre doğrudan hedeflenen tedaviler
uygulanabilir. Tümör besleyici damarların tıkandığı kemoembolizasyon, radyofrekans ve mikrodalga
ablasyon gibi yöntemlerle sağlıklı dokular korunarak tedavi gerçekleştirilir. Bu tedaviler,
cerrahiye uygun olmayan veya ek tedaviye ihtiyaç duyan uygun hastalarda güvenle kullanılabilir.

[Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi][Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi]

### Erektil Disfonksiyon
### Tedavisi

Organik sertleşme sorununun çoğunluğunu damarsal sertleşme bozuklukları oluşturur. Genç yaşlarda
çoğunlukla toplardamar kaçakları sebep olur ve embolizasyon yapılabilir. Atar damar kökenli olanlar
ileri yaşlarda ortaya çıkar. Tıkalı damarların balon veya stent ile tedavisi hedeflenir.

[Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi][Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi]

### Beyin Damar
### Hastalıkları Tedavisi

Beyin damar tıkanıklıkları, anevrizmalar ve damar yumakları gibi hastalıklar, anjiyografik
yöntemlerle uygun hastalarda ameliyatsız olarak tedavi edilebilir. Balon, stent ve coil uygulamaları
sayesinde damar içinden yapılan girişimlerle kan akımı düzenlenir ve beyin dokusu korunur. Erken
tanı ve hızlı müdahale, kalıcı hasar riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

## Tedaviler

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da damar ve organ hastalıklarının tanı ve tedavisinde minimal
invaziv yöntemler uygulayan deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktorudur. Modern görüntüleme
sistemleri eşliğinde cerrahi gerektirmeyen, güvenli ve etkili tedavi çözümleri sunar.

Girişimsel radyoloji, anjiyo, embolizasyon, biyopsi, tümör ablasyonu, varis ve damar
tıkanıklıklarının tedavisi gibi işlemleri kapsar. Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, bu işlemleri
ultrason, bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) ve anjiyografi rehberliğinde yüksek hassasiyetle
gerçekleştirir.

Deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktoru olarak Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, karaciğer tümörleri,
rahim miyomları, böbrek ve damar hastalıklarında cerrahiye alternatif minimal invaziv teknikler
uygular. Bu yöntemler, hastada daha az ağrı, daha kısa iyileşme süresi ve düşük komplikasyon riski
sağlar.

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, her hastası için kişiye özel tedavi planı oluşturur. Multidisipliner
yaklaşımıyla onkoloji, kalp-damar cerrahisi ve nöroloji uzmanlarıyla iş birliği yaparak en uygun
çözümü sunar. Hedef; etkin, güvenli ve hastaya konfor sağlayan tedavidir.

### Boyun Fıtığı Tedavileri

Ozon, radyofrekans veya lazer diskektomi yöntemlerinden kişiye uygun olanseçilerek fıtığın içine
iğne ile girerek küçültücü işlem (farmako termal regresyon) yapılır. Yaklaşık 3 ay içinde fıtık
geriler ve sinir basısı azalır.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi]

### Ameliyatsız Tiroid
### Tedavisi

Ciltten girimle (Radyofrekans, Mikrodalga, Kriyoablasyon) nodül yakılarak (ablasyon) ya da çok büyük
guatrlarda ve de Basedow Graves hastalığında embolizasyon yöntemiyle, ameliyatsız olarak 30 dakikada
tedavi sağlanır. Nodüller küçülür ve semptomlar giderilir ve hastalar tiroid ilacı kullanmazlar.

[Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri][Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri]

### Kanser Hastalıkları
### Tedavileri

Kanser tedavisinde girişimsel radyoloji yöntemleriyle, tümöre doğrudan hedeflenen tedaviler
uygulanabilir. Tümör besleyici damarların tıkandığı kemoembolizasyon, radyofrekans ve mikrodalga
ablasyon gibi yöntemlerle sağlıklı dokular korunarak tedavi gerçekleştirilir. Bu tedaviler,
cerrahiye uygun olmayan veya ek tedaviye ihtiyaç duyan uygun hastalarda güvenle kullanılabilir.

[Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi][Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi]

### Erektil Disfonksiyon
### Tedavisi

Organik sertleşme sorununun çoğunluğunu damarsal sertleşme bozuklukları oluşturur. Genç yaşlarda
çoğunlukla toplardamar kaçakları sebep olur ve embolizasyon yapılabilir. Atar damar kökenli olanlar
ileri yaşlarda ortaya çıkar. Tıkalı damarların balon veya stent ile tedavisi hedeflenir.

[Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi][Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi]

### Beyin Damar
### Hastalıkları Tedavisi

Beyin damar tıkanıklıkları, anevrizmalar ve damar yumakları gibi hastalıklar, anjiyografik
yöntemlerle uygun hastalarda ameliyatsız olarak tedavi edilebilir. Balon, stent ve coil uygulamaları
sayesinde damar içinden yapılan girişimlerle kan akımı düzenlenir ve beyin dokusu korunur. Erken
tanı ve hızlı müdahale, kalıcı hasar riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

## Tedaviler

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da damar ve organ hastalıklarının tanı ve tedavisinde minimal
invaziv yöntemler uygulayan deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktorudur. Modern görüntüleme
sistemleri eşliğinde cerrahi gerektirmeyen, güvenli ve etkili tedavi çözümleri sunar.

Girişimsel radyoloji, anjiyo, embolizasyon, biyopsi, tümör ablasyonu, varis ve damar
tıkanıklıklarının tedavisi gibi işlemleri kapsar. Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, bu işlemleri
ultrason, bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) ve anjiyografi rehberliğinde yüksek hassasiyetle
gerçekleştirir.

Deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktoru olarak Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, karaciğer tümörleri,
rahim miyomları, böbrek ve damar hastalıklarında cerrahiye alternatif minimal invaziv teknikler
uygular. Bu yöntemler, hastada daha az ağrı, daha kısa iyileşme süresi ve düşük komplikasyon riski
sağlar.

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, her hastası için kişiye özel tedavi planı oluşturur. Multidisipliner
yaklaşımıyla onkoloji, kalp-damar cerrahisi ve nöroloji uzmanlarıyla iş birliği yaparak en uygun
çözümü sunar. Hedef; etkin, güvenli ve hastaya konfor sağlayan tedavidir.

[Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT)][119]
[Rlab HBOT leverages Henry's Law to increase dissolved oxygen in blood plasma. This non-invasive
therapy boosts cellular energy (ATP), accelerates healing, and reduces inflammation by penetrating
hypoxic tissues. Combining medical-grade engineering with intelligent safety, it is ideal for sports
recovery, wellness, and anti-aging.][120]

[Red Light Therapy][122]
[Red Light Therapy (RLT), also known as Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT), Low Power Laser Therapy
(LPLT) and Photobiomodulation (PBM), is a treatment that utilizes specific wavelengths of red and
infrared light to penetrate the skin and reach the mitochondria within the cells to enhance
mitochondrial function to rejuvenate the cells.][123]
[ [Intermittent Hypoxic Hyperoxic Treatment] ][124]
[Intermittent Hypoxic Hyperoxic Treatment][125]
[Intermittent Hypoxia Hyperoxia Treatmen (IHHT) is a treatment that differs from traditional oxygen
therapy. breathe through the mask for approximately 40 minutes, periodically increasing and
decreasing the amount of oxygen you breathe.][126]
[ [Cryotherapy] ][127]
[Cryotherapy][128]
[Cryotherapy, sometimes known as cold therapy, is a treatment technique in which the body is exposed
to an environment of approximately -110℃ to -200℃ for 2-3 minutes to stimulate the body's defenses
against inflammation and pain. Use extremely low temperatures to treat disease, relieve
inflammation, reduce pain, or improve body function.][129]

[Float Therapy][131]
[Float therapy (also known as sensory deprivation therapy) is a method of relaxing in an environment
that provides maximum isolation from outside stimuli by floating in warm water containing Epsom
salts. Can help people achieve a state of deep relaxation, meditation and peace of mind.][132]

It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

traditional textile capital of South India, attained an iconic reputation since its inception in

Coimbatore city . As we are the Best Multi speciality Hospital In Coimbatore in many ways become a
part of medical history. In fact, it has been an integral part of the healthcare industry of modern
India. Our goal being the Best Hospital In Coimbatore is to be consistent with delivering the best

services, spanning from primary care to specialized treatments. Whether you're seeking routine
check-ups, diagnostic procedures, surgical interventions, or rehabilitation services, our expert
team of physicians, nurses, and staff is here to guide you through every step of your healthcare
journey.

We work extensively with a variety of equipment including Ultra Low Temperature (ULT) storage,
environmental test chambers, freeze driers, process cooling and cryotherapy chambers. We support the
design, manufacturing, installation and service of this equipment. For inquiries, email us at
[**sales@tpointsi.com**][27].

[ULT Equipment & Servicing][28]

## HawkEye Monitoring Systems

### ULT System Monitoring & Maintenance

An exciting addition to our range of products is [**HawkEye®.**][29] This versatile platform
provides for the following features and applications:
* Equipment monitoring and diagnostics
* Reactive Monitoring, Predictive and Prescriptive Maintenance
* IOT (Internet of Things)
* Web-based Point of Sale capability
* User-controlled experiences (Cryotherapy)

electric whole body cryotherapy accessible, profitable, and life-changing for all.

experience, has empowered countless studio owners to build thriving businesses while making

  2025-10-30

  2025-10-30
  
  Our factory address:
  Room 402, Building A, Baocheng Creative Industrial Base, Lishui Town, Nanhai District, Foshan
  City, Guangdong, China.
  Factory visits are warmly welcomed. We can arrange:
   • On-site tour
   • Live machine demonstration
   • Technical & business discussion
  If you arrive at Guangzhou Baiyun Airport or stay in Guangzhou, we can provide pickup and
  drop-off.
  Just share your schedule in advance and we will arrange everything smoothly.[【detailed】][68]

  2025-10-30
  
  We offer multiple shipping options:
  • Express courier: DHL / UPS / FedEx
  • DDP dedicated lines: door-to-door service (tax & customs handled if needed)
  • Your forwarder: We fully cooperate and deliver to your agent
  Pre-shipment confirmation:
  Before shipping, we send you:
  • Machine testing video
  • Real packaging photos
  Only after your approval do we dispatch the goods.
  Lead time:
  • Standard models: about 15 working days after order confirmation
  • Large volume or custom OEM/ODM orders: production schedule confirmed in advance
